Biography as supplied.

Carlos is a PhD candidate developing Bayesian frameworks for biosecurity risk assessment. His dissertation focuses on probabilistic models for predicting evolutionary outcomes in synthetic biological systems under uncertainty.

Areas of expertise

Computational Biology · Bayesian Inference · Risk Assessment

  • MSc in Applied Mathematics · TU Berlin · 2022
  • BSc in Mathematics · FU Berlin · 2020

Research interests

  • Uncertainty quantification
  • Computational inference methods
  • Decision theory in biosecurity
